alternatives: Cadence, token/capacity gates or cache readiness can delay admission independent of sorting.
An increase in observed long waits can mean old backlog is finally being admitted; still-waiting requests remain censored.
Closed-loop trajectory progress and cache locality change with policy; total input length is not uncached work.
rules.check: Use source-defined queue histogram bucket/count/sum deltas by rank and observation time, plus finalized client request-start strata and cancellations. rules.reject_if: No improvement in finalized tails/backlog or trajectory progress, or unacceptable loss of qualified total/output throughput or latency Pareto position. Do not accept based only on fewer emitted long-wait observations.

policy.units: Keep rank/process labels; encounter counts are not unique requests, wait seconds or fallback percentages.
policy.window: First characterize the full canonical AgentX hour. Read changing workload/cache regimes with graph evidence throughout; consistent early windows do not establish the whole replay.
policy.early_stop: Full baseline/candidate runs continue through the requested measurement unless safety or invalidity requires stopping. Shorter diagnostic sections need an explicit, previously calibrated question.
policy.promotion: Use complete canonical runs, validity/accounting and refreshed latency/throughput frontiers for candidate ranking. Calibrate shorter sections against full-run outcomes later; retain missed regimes and counterexamples.
policy.unknown: Missing producers/events are unknown, not zero; add discriminating instrumentation when alternatives remain.
policy.finalization: Traffic completion, zero request errors and latency coverage do not by themselves establish a qualified result. Require complete canonical exports, validation and final accounting. Preserve artifacts durably from launch; distinguish external resource-guard termination from serving OOM.
